 a priest or Ṛtvij who is employed at Soma sacrifices, and is a co-adjutor
 of {#hotf#}. Each of the four principal priests, {#hotf, aDvaryu, udgAtf#}
 and {#brahman#} has three assistants, the total number of priests employed
 at Soma sacrifices being therefore 16; {#˚sAman#} {%a.%} <ab>N.</ab> of the Sāman
